lines.vo: In May 1945, Virginia wrote a letter to her husband Rolf, a sailor in the Norwegian Navy.
lines.label: May 1945

lines.vo: She asked if he was as lonesome for her as she was for him.
She told him about the baby she was carrying.
But the letter never reached him.
For seventy-two years, nobody knew where it went.
lines.label: Then...

lines.vo: It slipped through a crack in a house in New Jersey, and vanished.
Seventy-two years later, renovators found it. Still sealed.
They posted it online. Within hours, strangers found Rolf's son.
Virginia had passed away six years earlier.
So his son read him the letter. Her words, seventy-two years late.
